review: The ore cart, standing entrance jamb and fallen timber use their own silhouettes for model overhangs on adjacent floor. Their ground contacts, the bucket, pick, walls and rock fall remain solid. The floor below the fallen timber is decorative and disconnected; the real mouth exit leads to screen 337 without inventing a walk-through or upper/lower shortcut.
